title: Link request observation
description: Open context written by SemanticLogLinker for a BEAR.Resource request with links (`#link=`). The resource_request entries of the requests made to follow the links nest in it, the first request's included, each with its own params. SemanticLogExtractor reads each of them as a root, since a client made them one after another; the link_request itself is never an event. The uri is canonical (path only).

links.description: Each link as type:rel, in the order it is followed. A link query is left out; the request that follows the link records it in its params.
